lines: The App Store looks for a line that begins with ## 5.4.1 or ## [5.4.1] (a v before the version is allowed), and shows what follows up to the next such heading; this release would show nothing.
CHANGELOG.en.md replaces CHANGELOG.md in the App Store.
Both are read as English and the App Store keeps the second, so CHANGELOG.md is not shown.
The App Store finds the section for 5.4.1 in 1 changelog.
